content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the Task Reporting page","i_want":"to sort the report tasks by Creation Date, Due Date, Status, Priority or Title","so_that":"I can review my tasks in the order that matters to me","business_description":"The Task Reporting page shows the user's tasks in a table. The user can choose one sort field (Creation Date, Due Date, Status, Priority or Title) and a sort direction, and the table and the report API return the tasks in that order.","business_value":"Sorting lets the user find the most urgent or oldest tasks quickly on the report page, without scanning the full table.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays at least two tasks with different Creation Dates","when":"The user selects the sort option Creation Date with the sort control set to ascending","then":"The table rows are ordered so that Creation Date values increase from the first row to the last, and the sort option shown as selected is Creation Date"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays at least two tasks with different Creation Dates","when":"The user selects the sort option Creation Date with the sort control set to descending","then":"The table rows are ordered so that Creation Date values decrease from the first row to the last, and the sort option shown as selected is Creation Date"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays at least two tasks with different Due Dates","when":"The user selects the sort option Due Date","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Due Date field and the sort option shown as selected is Due Date"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays at least two tasks with different Status values","when":"The user selects the sort option Status","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Status field and the sort option shown as selected is Status"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays at least two tasks with different Priority values","when":"The user selects the sort option Priority","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Priority field and the sort option shown as selected is Priority"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays at least two tasks with different titles","when":"The user selects the sort option Title","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Title field and the sort option shown as selected is Title"},{"given":"The report API is called with a sort field of creation_date, due_date, status, priority or title","when":"The sort option and the backend sort request fails","when":"The failed response is received by the Frontend","then":"The table keeps the previous row order, the previously selected sort option stays selected, and an error message is shown"}],"edge_cases":["Two or more tasks have the same value in the selected sort field: the PRD does not state the order between them. Open question: which tie-breaker to use (for example, Creation Date or Title).","The PRD does not state the order of Status values (Open, In Progress, Completed) or Priority values (Low, Medium, High). Open question: sort by the declared order of the values or alphabetically.","A task with no Due Date or no Completion Date: the PRD does not state how empty values are placed in the order. Open question: whether empty values sort first or last.","The sort parameter is missing from the report request: the PRD does not state a default sort. Open question: the default order of the report table.","The sort is combined with filters and title search on the same report endpoint.
